subject: Upcoming Flight Confirmation
body: Dear John, This email is to confirm your upcoming flight from New York to London on August 15th. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 10:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 3 hours before the departure time. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Airlines Team
